summary.tagline: Schiermonnikoog National Park is a national park in the Dutch province of Friesland. It was founded in 1989. I

days.title: Coastal Waters and Dunes
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Nordsee
stops.detail: The national park includes the areas of the open North Sea bordering the island of Schiermonnikoog to the north and the Wadden Sea to the south, which falls dry at low tide.

stops.name: Wattenmeer
stops.detail: The Wadden Sea around the island is also one of the Dutch World Heritage sites.

days.title: Interior Landscapes and Forests
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Inselwälder
stops.detail: The island forests on Schiermonnikoog, which consist of both coniferous and deciduous trees, are unusual.

stops.name: Strandabschnitten
stops.detail: The terrestrial part of the park offers a varied landscape with constantly changing dunes, beach sections, island forests and salt marshes.
